name: Acxiom
notes: Acxiom is a marketing data wholesaler, so opting out here cuts off data that flows on to many other brokers. The form asks for name, address, phone and email, then Acxiom sends a confirmation link from noreply-optout@acxiom.com. If the form fails, consumeradvo@acxiom.com is Acxiom's consumer advocate address.
source: Process per redact.dev's Acxiom removal guide (updated 2026-09-10).
